title: Sleeveless Cable Knit & Shearling Boots
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair stands in a full-length pose against a pale studio backdrop. She wears a gray sleeveless mock-neck cable-knit top with a diamond cable pattern and a cropped halter back, paired with a short gray wool mini skirt. Tall dark gray suede boots with plush fur trim and buckle straps complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of heathered gray, charcoal, and cream. Sleek and cozy, in the style of a minimalist winter catalog.
workingNotes:
- The cable knit and fur-trimmed boots are the texture pairing.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
